decisions.reason: Only a website mention still limits public commitment, but the product builds on an established offer and has now survived two years, so escalation keeps it while moderate withdrawal risk remains.
A dedicated product page and closeness to the established offer create strong public commitment and centrality, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The multi-model product line represents large sunk investment and visible commitment, so escalation strongly favors keeping the line.
As a recently launched system close to the firm's core spraying offer, management attributes any weak early results to temporary causes and is inclined to continue.
